resources.string: The server keeps no recovery passphrase.
The server keeps the sync key locked with a recovery passphrase.
Anyone with a copy of the server can try passphrases without limit: use several unrelated words that you use nowhere else, at least 20 characters.
Recover the key with the passphrase
Opening the recovery escrow, which takes a while…
Provider keys synced: %1$s. The phone keeps them sealed by the Android keystore for the computers that use them.
